title: XdistRemovalDoc
description:
The `--xdist-removal-json` document (schema 1). Fields are alphabetical, as
in the other migrate documents.

ready.description:
Whether pytest-xdist can be uninstalled now (no non-allowed blocking
finding, and the trial passed when it ran).

trial.description: The `--xdist-trial` result: `null` when the trial was not requested.

xdist_version.description:
The installed pytest-xdist version: `null` when it is not installed or
the interpreter could not be probed.

MigrateMeta.description: Envelope metadata shared by the migrate documents.

RemovalFinding.description: One thing that breaks or changes when pytest-xdist is removed.

allowed.description: Whether this location is on the `--migrate-allow` list.

blocking.description:
Whether it breaks the run once xdist is gone (`false`: a behavior
change or a warning).

location.description:
Where it is: a config source (`pytest.ini addopts`, `PYTEST_ADDOPTS`)
or `path:line`.

text.description: The offending flag, key, or source line.

why.description: What happens once pytest-xdist is gone.

TrialReport.description: Result of the `--xdist-trial` run with `-p no:xdist`.

baseline_error.description:
The tail of the child's stderr when pytest-xdist is installed but the
run with it loaded never started, so nothing could be compared.

compared.description:
Whether a run with pytest-xdist loaded was compared against (`false`
when it isn't installed, so nothing can be called a regression).

error.description: The tail of the child's stderr when the session never started.

failed.description: Tests that failed with xdist hidden.

regressions.description:
Tests that pass with pytest-xdist loaded but fail (or are no longer
collected) with it hidden.

started.description: Whether the session with xdist hidden started and reported outcomes.

tests.description: Tests that ran with xdist hidden.
